Fig. 1. Budget-aware uncertainty visualization on three axial slices from a representative case (AUTOMI 0007), comparing DE and CE+TS+TTA. The first and fourth rows overlay the filled ground truth (green) and prediction (red). Subsequent rows show entropy-based uncertainty maps thresholded by uncertainvolume budgets (top-0.5%, 1%, and 2% most uncertain voxels), displayed with the ground-truth contour (green). DE at 2% is omitted since not informative, i.e., < 1% of voxels have non-zero uncertainty.
